transcript.statement: The requirements SAF-01 to SAF-07 are crucial for ensuring the safety and reliability of the ATM system. SAF-01 prevents negative balances, ensuring user trust and financial security. SAF-02 and SAF-03 ensure that users are not left in a vulnerable state when funds are insufficient, thereby safeguarding against potential financial mishaps. SAF-04 guarantees that all transactions are logged for accountability, while SAF-05 secures user authentication, preventing unauthorized access. SAF-06 allows for safe degradation during maintenance, and SAF-07 provides clear user feedback, enhancing their understanding of account status. Together, these requirements form a robust framework for safety and reliability.

transcript.statement: The requirements RES-01 to RES-07 are essential for ensuring ethical compliance and accountability in the ATM system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, protecting consumers and the institution. RES-02 guarantees that transaction logs are comprehensive, fostering transparency. RES-03 prevents negative account balances, promoting fairness in financial transactions. RES-04 secures user identity through PIN verification, ensuring responsible access. RES-05 mandates that funds are withdrawn only when sufficient, minimizing user risk. RES-06 provides immediate notifications for insufficient funds, enhancing user awareness. RES-07 ensures user privacy through data encryption, reflecting social responsibility. Together, these requirements uphold ethical standards and regulatory compliance.

transcript.statement: The requirements EFF-01 to EFF-07 are critical for ensuring high performance efficiency in the ATM system. EFF-01 guarantees that transactions are processed swiftly within 3 seconds, enhancing user experience. EFF-02 ensures a minimum transaction throughput of 100 transactions per minute, vital for handling peak usage. transcript.statement: The requirements TRU-01 to TRU-07 are vital for ensuring the security and privacy of transactions within the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures encryption during transmission, safeguarding sensitive data from interception. TRU-02 reinforces secure user authentication through PIN codes, preventing unauthorized access. transcript.statement: The requirements GRN-01 to GRN-07 are essential for ensuring the sustainability of the ATM system. GRN-01 focuses on minimizing energy consumption during transaction processing, which is crucial for reducing the system's overall carbon footprint. GRN-02 mandates the provision of carbon footprint reports for each transaction, enhancing transparency and promoting environmentally conscious choices. GRN-03 emphasizes the use of energy-efficient hardware components, while GRN-04 ensures that transaction logging minimizes data storage requirements, thus conserving resources. GRN-05 offers clients an option for electronic records, reducing paper waste. GRN-06 promotes energy conservation by shutting down during inactivity, and GRN-07 emphasizes annual environmental assessments. Together, these requirements promote responsible resource use and align with modern sustainability goals.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account only when sufficient funds are available.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance efficiently.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
